result.description: A fictional handheld respiratory mist generator designed for quiet tabletop use in home wellness settings. The Aster Quill 14L features a compact reservoir, USB-C charging, and a low-noise atomization chamber intended for saline-only inhalation routines. It is presented as a consumer health accessory rather than a computing or storage device.
